result.interpretation: OBSERVED: both reduced valid-affine inputs reproduce the historical retained-frontier failure on 520 with the unchanged bound, 97 warm pages and the first failing reading above 129. The one 2-word node per iteration (own_cons) and the 4-word Cons rebuild (own_rebox) are sufficient; sums, &2, closures and caller residual use are not required. The measured runs do not prove which source change causes the failure; the missing release is observed in the emitted arm, and its causal sufficiency for the fresh image is untested.
